goal: Reject out-of-range numeric configuration options early during node startup
Prevent silent integer overflows that can break syncing, database flushing, or mempool limits
reviewability: Worth reviewing now because no rebases or major rework are pending
agreement: Support for rejecting invalid arguments with clear startup errors (ryanofsky, fjahr, l0rinc)
Unaddressed objection against piecemeal fixes instead of central validation (sedited)
Unaddressed objections on integer types, test lifetime bugs, and saturation (maflcko, l0rinc)
Verified by testing changed options on regtest (ryanofsky)

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it prevents misconfigurations from silently producing broken node states
Node operators get early startup errors instead of unexpected crashes or stuck syncs
The impact is limited to catching invalid or nonsensical command-line parameters
